candidates.name: Papillary Thyroid Carcinoma
support_spans: a large, firm, mildly tender mass on the right side of the neck without fixation
Fine-needle aspiration biopsy of the right lobe yielded a hemorrhagic background with isolated clusters of pleomorphic round and oval nuclei
candidates.why: The patient's presentation of a large neck mass, positive Pemberton sign, and fine-needle aspiration biopsy results are consistent with papillary thyroid carcinoma.

candidates.name: Anaplastic Thyroid Carcinoma
support_spans: a large, firm, mildly tender mass on the right side of the neck without fixation
the entire right lobe was replaced by a hypo- to anechoic mass measuring approximately 6 × 4 × 6 cm, displacing the trachea 1 cm to the left
candidates.why: The rapid growth and aggressive nature of the tumor are suggestive of anaplastic thyroid carcinoma.
